title: [Riso] Lesson List SF – New Lesson – Vacant Classroom – Available Classroom is saved
description: F01 / AC 01.2 — Scenario — Lesson List SF availability.
preconditions: - HQ or CM Staff is logged in to Riso.\n- Room F01 is vacant at Tokyo Center.
steps_actions: 1. "HQ or CM Staff creates a Lesson with Room F01."\n2. "HQ or CM Staff saves the Lesson."
steps_result: 1. "Room F01 is selectable."\n2. "Saved Lesson displays Room F01."

title: [Riso] Lesson SF – Edit Lesson – Changed start time – Classroom resets to blank
description: F02 / AC 01.3 — State Transition — SF edit reset.
preconditions: - HQ or CM Staff is logged in to Riso.\n- Editable Lesson has Room F02.
steps_actions: 1. "HQ or CM Staff changes start time to 11:00 JST."\n2. "HQ or CM Staff saves without a Classroom."

title: [Riso] Lesson Schedule Detail – Add Lesson – Occupied Classroom – Classroom is unavailable
description: F03 / AC 01.2 — Scenario / Negative — Added lesson availability.
preconditions: - HQ or CM Staff is logged in to Riso.\n- Room F03 has 2026-09-15 10:00–11:00 JST lesson.
steps_actions: 1. "HQ or CM Staff adds a Lesson for 10:00–11:00 JST."\n2. "HQ or CM Staff opens the Classroom selector."
steps_result: 1. "Classroom selector is available."\n2. "Room F03 is absent."

title: [Riso] Lesson Schedule Detail – Extend Recurrence – First occurrence vacant – Classroom can be selected
description: F04 / AC 01.4 — State Transition — Selected recurrence instance.
preconditions: - HQ or CM Staff is logged in to Riso.\n- Room F04 is vacant for first occurrence.
steps_actions: 1. "HQ or CM Staff selects 2026-09-15 10:00–11:00 JST in Extend Recurrence."\n2. "HQ or CM Staff saves with Room F04."
steps_result: 1. "Room F04 is selectable."\n2. "Extended Lesson uses Room F04."

title: [Riso] Lesson SF – Duplicate Lesson – Duplicated Classroom conflicts – Save is rejected
description: F05 / AC 02.1 — Regression / Negative — Duplicate conflict is blocked.
preconditions: - HQ or CM Staff is logged in to Riso.\n- Another Lesson uses Room F05 at target interval.
steps_actions: 1. "HQ or CM Staff duplicates to 2026-09-15 10:00–11:00 JST."\n2. "HQ or CM Staff saves stale Room F05."
steps_result: 1. "Room F05 is re-evaluated."\n2. "Save is rejected with Room F05 is already in use for another class."

title: [Riso] Back Office – Edit Lesson – Vacant Classroom – Updated Classroom persists
description: F06 / AC 01.2 — Permission Matrix / Regression — Permitted BO edit.
preconditions: - HQ Staff is logged in to Back Office with Classroom permission.\n- Room F06 is vacant.
steps_actions: 1. "HQ Staff selects Room F06 in Back Office."\n2. "HQ Staff saves the Lesson."
steps_result: 1. "Room F06 is selectable."\n2. "Back Office Lesson displays Room F06."
